extensionHelp1.message: This is a browser extension to access a linked ANOTHERpass vault.

extensionHelp2.message: To use this extension you need the ANOTHERpass Android app on your mobile device. More details about this extension can be found here.

extensionHelp3.message: To get it working, you have to link the extension with your ANOTHERpass app by clicking on the link icon 🔗 displayed above :-)

lblNext.description: Button label for moving to the next step

lblImportAndClose.description: Button label for importing a credential and closing something

vaultUnlocked.description: Lock status about the local vault

vaultLocked.description: Lock status about the local vault

localVaultLocked.description: states that the local vault is explicitly locked

messageLocalVaultUnlocked.description: states that the local vault is explicitly unlocked

lblNoLocalCredentials.description: Indicates no stored local credentials in the local vault

lblPassword.description: A label for a password field

lblRepeatPassword.description: A label for a repeat-password field

hintInputPassword.message: Remember to select a hard to guess password
hintInputPassword.description: A hint as tooltip on password input fields

errorPasswordTooShort.description: Error shown if a password entered in a password field is too short

errorPasswordDiffers.description: Error shown if a password entered in a password field differs to the repeat-password field

titleConfigureLocalVaultPassword.description: Title of a dialog to configure a local vault password

messageConfigureLocalVaultPassword.message: For more convinience you can configure a local vault password to unlock the local vault without the need of using the ANOTHERpass app. You may still use the app to unlock at any time.
messageConfigureLocalVaultPassword.description: Message of a dialog to configure a local vault password

successMessageConfigureLocalVaultPasswor.description: Success-Message of a dialog after configuring a local vault password

titleRemoveLocalVaultPassword.description: Title of a dialog to remove the configured local vault password

messageRemoveLocalVaultPassword.message: You are about to delete the local vault password. That means you will only be able to unlock the local vault with the ANOTHERpass app. Continue?
messageRemoveLocalVaultPassword.description: Message of a dialog to remove the configured local vault password

successMessageRemoveLocalVaultPassword.description: Success-Message of a dialog after removing the local vault password

titleLockLocalVault.description: Title of a dialog to lock the local vault

titleUnlockLocalVault.description: Title of a dialog to unlock the local vault with a password or the app

messageUnlockLocalVault.message: Enter the password to unlock the local vault or use the ANOTHERpass app.
messageUnlockLocalVault.description: Message of a dialog to unlock the local vault with a password or the app

successMessageUnlockLocalVault.message: Extension successfully un-linked from the app! You can now remove the linked device $linkId$ from your app.
successMessageUnlockLocalVault.description: Success message of a dialog if unlocking the local vault with a password was successful

errorMessageUnlockLocalVault.message: Cannot unlock the local vault with provided password. Wrong password?
errorMessageUnlockLocalVault.description: Error message of a dialog if unlocking the local vault with a password has failed

messageLocalVaultIsLocked.message: Local vault is locked, unlock first or fetch credential from the app.
messageLocalVaultIsLocked.description: More comprehensive message displayed if the local vault is locked

lblUseTheApp.description: Button label to initiate the app flow to unlock the local vault

lblLinkedState.description: Label to indicate a linked extension (with the app) and the link id

lblNotLinkedState.description: Label to indicate an unlinked extension (with the app)

messageUnlinkFromApp.message: Are you sure to unlink $linkId$ from the app? This will also wipe the local vault with all local credentials.

lblUnlink.description: Label on a buton to unlink the extension

linkedVaultId.description: To what ANOTHERpass vault id the extension is linked to

tooltipFetchSingleCredential.message: Fetch single credential from the app

tooltipCreateNewCredential.message: Create new credential in the app

tooltipFetchMultipleCredentials.message: Fetch a selection of credentials from the app

tooltipFetchAllCredentials.message: Fetch all credential from the app, except veiled

tooltipDownloadBackupFile.message: Download the encrypted vault backup file from the app

tooltipSynchronizeAll.message: Synchronize all local credentials with the app

tooltipSortOrder.message: Change the sort order of the local credentials

messageDeleteAllLocalCredentials.message: Are you sure to delete all credentials from the local vault? This wont delete any credenial from the linked device.

tooltipDeleteAllLocalCredentials.message: Delete all local credentials from the local vault

lblCredential.description: A label used to combine with a credential name

tooltipApplyCredentialToWebsite.message: Apply this credential on current website

tooltipSyncCredentialWithApp.message: Synchronise this credential with the app

tooltipDeleteCredential.message: Delete this credential from the local vault

messageDeleteCredential.message: Are you sure to delete this credential from the local vault?

lblSettingsColorThemeAuto.description: Means automatically light or dark theme, controlled by the OS

lblIconPosition.message: Position of the icon in the text field

lblSettingsAutoLock.message: Minutes of inactivity after the unlocked local vault is locked

lblSettingsRenderIcon.message: Display a credential-icon in each username and password input field. Note: All websites need to be reloaded if these settings have been changed!

lblSettingsHostWithAppName.message: ANOTHERpass app hostname, handle or IP address

lblSettingsPort.description: hostname and port kind of belongs together

lblSettingsPollingTimeout.message: The extension polls for credentials with this timeout in seconds
lblSettingsPollingTimeout.description: How long shall the extension poll the app host to retrieve data

lblSettingsPollingIntervall.description: In which intervall shall the extension poll the app host to retrieve data

lblChooseHostAlternative.description: Means app host or handle or ip alternatives

errorMessageMissingAppServer.message: A handle, hostname or IP address is required.

errorMessageInvalidAppServer.message: Invalid handle, hostname or IP address.

errorMessageInvalidAppPort.message: A nummeric port number is required, which should be between 1024 and 49151.

errorMessageInvalidPollingTimeout.message: Invalid polling timeout, should be a number between 1 and 300.

errorMessageInvalidPollingInterval.message: Invalid polling interval, should be a number between 1 and 60.

errorMessageInvalidLockTimeout.message: Invalid lock timeout, should be a number between 1 and 10080.

errorMessageInvalidOpacityValue.message: Invalid icon opacity, should be a number between 1 and 100.

messageManageServers.message: All app addresses in this list can be used to connect to the ANOTHERpass app. For example if you use a laptop in a different network, the host address of your mobile to connect can differ.

tooltipResolvedHandle.message: This handle will be translated to $ip$
tooltipResolvedHandle.description: Explains which IP address is encoded in this handle

lblAppHost.description: Indicates the app host as hostname, IP address or handle

errorMessageInvalidAppHost.message: IP, handle or hostname is invalid

lblAddressMarkedForDeletion.description: Explains that the given app host address is going to be removed once saved.

titleRequestApproval.message: Request approval via the ANOTHERpass app

lblAppRequestRememberSelection.message: Remember my selection for this website

lblAppRequestSaveSelection.message: Save my selection in the local vault

errorMessageExtensionNotLinked.message: The extension is not linked with an ANOTHERpass app! Please link it first.

errorMessageRequestRejected.message: The request has been rejected in the app or the app vault was locked.

errorMessageCommunicationFailure.message: Failed to communicate with the app. Updating the app could solve this problem.

errorMessageSomethingWentWrong.message: Something went wrong. Make sure you have the latest version installed. If this error persists, please report it.

errorMessageRequestTimedOut.message: You didn't open the app in reasonable time or the app address or port is incorrect.

successMessageCredentialsImported.description: Success message of fetching many credentials

successMessageCredentialsSynchronised.description: Success message of synchronising many credentials

successMessageCredentialSynchronised.description: Success message of synchronising one particular credential

textAppRequestHint.message: Take your mobile device, open the ANOTHERpass app, start the server and follow the instructions.

lblAppRequestMessageCreateNewCredential.message: Request to create a new credential in the app

lblAppRequestMessageDownloadVaultFile.message: Request to download the vault backup file from the app

messageAppVaultFileDownload.message: Although the vault backup file is encrypted, it contains metadata about your vault. You should only download the vault backup file in a trusted local network. Continue?

messageAppLinking.message: Scan this QR code with the ANOTHERpass app, enter the provided app address and click Next. The linking-process may take a few minutes.

messageAppReLinking.message: Open the ANOTHERpass app with vault id $vaultId$, scan the QR code below, enter the provided app address and click Next. The re-linking-process may take a few minutes.

errorMessageAlreadyLinked.message: This extension is already linked with the app!

messageConfirmAppLink.message: Ensure that the fingerprint $fingerprint$ matches the one shown in the app and don't forget to accept there too.

successMessageAppLink.message: The extension was successfully linked to the vault $vaultId$ with the link identifier $linkId$.

errorMessageAppLinkDenied.message: Linking the extension has been denied in the app.

errorMessageAppUnknownError.message: Cannot link with the app due to an unknown problem. Open the app and try again.

errorMessageAppHostUnreachable.message: Unable to connect to the app. Check that the handle, IP or hostname are correct and that you have scanned the QR code with the ANOTHERpass app.

errorMessageAppVaultDiffers.message: Cannot relink to a different vault id ($remoteVaultId$). Current: $localVaultId$

errorMessageAppLinkInProgress.message: It seems there a different linking phase in progress. Please finish or close this one first.
